name: Sangyarishi (Astradhari Archetype)
body:
Not all warriors approach battle in the same way. In fact, a handful of legendary figures are attributed with the creation or mastery of the martial disciplines known to initiators. Sangyarishi are warrior sages that approach combat as a prayer to gods and heroes. In exchange for their supplications, they receive divine inspiration that enables them to fight like the legendary figures they offer obeisance, at least momentarily.

Skills

A Sangyarishi adds Knowledge (Martial) to, and removes Knowledge (Arcane) from, their list of class skills. For the purposes of learning new astras, Sangyarishi use Knowledge (Religion) instead. This modifies class skills.

Devotee

Sangyarishi abilities are powered by their will and their devotion to the original users of their astras. They use their Wisdom modifier for any astradhari class features that normally use their Intelligence modifier, and for their initiation modifier. They also treat their astradhari levels as initiator levels for all purposes.

Divine Inspiration (Su)

Rather than searching through the akashic records for extra combat abilities, Sangyarishi are granted maneuvers whenever they summon an astra. For every astra they learn, they choose a single martial discipline that counts the astra’s weapon form among its associated weapons. For example, Trishula of the Sun is a veil that can take the shape of a trident, and as such can be associated with any discipline that counts spears or thrown among their weapons, such as Scarlet Throne or Solar Wind. At 1st level, whenever they summon a weapon astra, they automatically enter a stance that they meet the prerequisites for from the associated discipline, though they are still limited to maintaining a single stance. This choice can be changed each time they summon an astra. This ability replaces the astradhari’s ability to summon armor astras.

Granted Maneuvers (Su)

At 2nd level, each time a Sangyarishi summons an astra, they are granted the knowledge of how to perform a non-stance maneuver from its associated discipline that they meet the prerequisites for. At 6th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, they can change the maneuver that an astra grants them and also learn a new one.

A Sangyarishi’s initiating is powered by divine inspiration, and functions differently than other initiators’. When Sangyarishi enter combat, they gain a number of inspiration points equal to their Wisdom modifier. This increases by one at the beginning of their turn, and by two if they take the total defense action. To initiate a maneuver, they have to pay a number of inspiration points equal to the maneuver’s level. If

Sangyarishi are out of inspiration points, they can gain 2 by taking a point of essence burn as a swift action. This ability replaces all instances of akashic style.

Improved Inspiration (Su)

At 7th level, and again at 15th, each time a Sangyarishi gains inspiration points the number is increased by one. This ability replaces the bonus feats gained at those levels.

Inspired Maneuvers & Extra Resources

Certain martial disciplines grant initiators additional resources associated with their use (e.g. Radiant Dawn – essence or Sleeping Goddess – power points).

Temporary access to a discipline, such as that enjoyed by a Sangyarishi, should not grant such benefits.

Sangyarishi and multiple astras

If a Sangyarishi summons 2 or more astras at the same time, they gain the option to change stances from those granted by their summoned astras as normal, and they pay for maneuvers granted by any of their summoned astras with the same pool of inspiration points.
